## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker computes `canLevelUp` via `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) = `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` and `level < 10`. Thresholds (`worker/src/types/index.ts:175`): 0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000. Returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` (`routes/action.ts:99`) and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/combat.ts:109`). Frontend shows banner in `character-sheet.component.html:66` and ability picker in `game-console.component.html:19-28`.

**Trigger:** `game-console.component.ts:183` `levelUp(key)` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`), validating `abilityChoice` ∈ str/dex/con/int/wis/cha and 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**Character changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- Level +1
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON mod`, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- Chosen ability score **+2** (no cap at 20)
- AC unchanged

**Response/aftermath:** Flavor text via `generateLevelUpNarrative`, a `[Level Up]` system log row, DM history turn (`routes/levelup.ts:39-50`); frontend then calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows system message, updates campaign slot level (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`). Only one level processed per call.
